args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring already declared banker's rounding, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. This made the nightly build fail on
tests/test_money.py, which expects half-even behavior (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/money-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The docstring already claimed half-even behavior; the implementation just didn't match.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (fixes `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`, e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).
